answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate an epoch polynomial to derive a scope-bound RLN share and nullifier. Messages within quota remain unlinkable; exceeding it repeats the nullifier, allowing a verifier to combine Shamir shares and recover the registered private key. The resulting proof triggers immediate collateral slashing. Meadow, pulse, and ocean may label distinct scopes; they do not create extra identities.
